reviews.text: I bought a product 1 month ago, but they did not ship it, they don't answer call  or emails . They are impolster. I reported it to police and my bank today
I absolutely advise against purchasing from them online. My order never arrived, they don't respond to emails, and they don't answer the phone. However, they did collect my money.

I bought a dog house and it arrived damaged. I returned it and they never heard from me again. No refund. The phone number doesn't exist. If they don't refund me, I'll file a complaint. Be careful before ordering. Terrible experience.
After the expected time, when you contact them via email they don't respond and if you call them they tell you that the number doesn't exist.

I made an online purchase, but after the expected delivery date, I still haven't received anything. Another week has passed, and I can't contact the store because they don't respond to emails or phone calls. Not recommended.
